methodology.Revenue: The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All DAO revenue accrues to the 1inch DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of each fill's swap fee retained by the LP inside the maker-owned wallet (Aqua is non-custodial): total fee minus the DAO share.

Fees.Aqua LP Swap Fees: Swap-fee share retained by LPs in their own wallets, priced per fill from the decoded position fee rate.
Fees.1inch DAO Fee Share: Swap-fee share transferred to the 1inch DAO fee exchanger at fill time, priced per fill from the decoded protocol-fee rate.

SupplySideRevenue.Aqua LP Swap Fees: LP-retained swap fees (total fee minus the DAO share).

Revenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: The DAO's decoded per-fill fee share (validated against fee-exchanger inflows).

ProtocolRevenue.1inch DAO Fee Share: DAO fee share accruing to the 1inch DAO treasury.
